sloka: चिन्तया बाध्यसे राजन् किमर्थं मयि तिष्ठति ।सो ऽहं शत्रुविनाशाय तव निर्यातुमुद्यतः ।। ६.६३.४८ ।।
transliteration: cintayā bādhyase rājan kimarthaṁ mayi tiṣṭhati ।so 'haṁ śatruvināśāya tava niryātumudyataḥ ।। 6.63.48 ।।

translations.english: "O King! while I am here for what reason do you worry and have anxiety? I will go now and decidedly destroy your enemy."
